request: Stop old cutout repairs. Regenerate every component using the Coopanion official mother-edit workflow; compare each output with mother and reject large deviations.
generation: Pure complete-component image generation/editing from the locked full mother. Each component is one continuous generated painting with generated alpha. No mother-pixel grafts, difference cutouts, contour reinsertion, hidden-pixel donors or programmed art repairs.
constraints: Same character, three-quarter view, age impression, proportions, palette, dark brown thin outlines, cel shading and highlight placement.
Keep both hands consistent with mother: only small fingertips exposed from oversized sailor cuffs.
Tied narrow outer locks are ponytails; broad neighboring hair is rear hair. Do not merge their identities.
Preserve original facial charm and flustered >< expression; no rejected generic mouth designs.
No seated torso squash, OpenArt, paid API fallback, or reuse of rejected cutouts.
Latest user reply forbids consuming Adobe credits. Earlier one-attempt approval is superseded; do not invoke Adobe generative operations that may consume credits.
Generated alpha owns new hidden contour; do not force it into previous masks.
Only registration, source comparison, compositing and export are programmatic; no improvised ink or shape patches.
rejection_policy: Reject notable shape, face, direction, scale or color drift. Save outcome and reason; never silently use a rejected component as the next reference.
